queries: WITH linked AS (SELECT s.telescref, o.weathprofile, s.modindex, s.phaseshiftdeg FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation), grp AS (SELECT telescref, weathprofile, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex, AVG(phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshift FROM linked GROUP BY telescref, weathprofile), overall AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg FROM linked) SELECT g.weathprofile, AVG(g.avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex, AVG(g.avg_phaseshift) AS avg_phaseshift, AVG(g.avg_modindex - ov.overall_avg) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall ov WHERE g.avg_modindex > ov.overall_avg GROUP BY g.weathprofile

assumptions.assumption: The overall average modulation index is the mean over all linked signal rows (after the inner joins), not the mean of the group averages. Null modindex values are ignored by AVG.
Per weather profile, the averages are unweighted means of the qualifying telescope/weather group averages (each group counts once, regardless of signal count).
'How far above the overall average' is the group average modindex minus the overall average, averaged across qualifying groups.
Inner joins drop signals with no matching telescope or observatory. Values are not rounded.

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average is the mean of the telescope/weather group averages, with each group weighted equally, instead of the mean over all signal rows.
